stories.name: Intel-SK Hynix Ohio Deal
stories.blurb: Intel is reportedly in talks with SK Hynix to manufacture memory chips at Intel's underused Ohio fab, boosting Intel's stock alongside a separate $15 billion capital raise for AI chip growth.

stories.name: Middle East market volatility
stories.blurb: Ongoing market swings driven by Middle East tensions, oil price moves, and uncertainty over the Strait of Hormuz.

stories.name: AMD stock surge
stories.blurb: A wave of bullish coverage argues AMD's AI and Microsoft partnership will drive its stock sharply higher, even as its valuation climbs.

stories.name: Intel Turnaround Rally
stories.blurb: Intel's stock and analyst sentiment have been rallying on optimism that its turnaround strategy and AI-driven demand are gaining traction ahead of and following Q2 earnings.

stories.name: AI chip selloff
stories.blurb: A broad selloff in AI-related chip and memory stocks, driven by bubble fears and weak guidance, is dragging down markets worldwide.

stories.name: Meta Muse AI Chip Rally
stories.blurb: Meta's new Muse AI agent sparked expectations of increased CPU demand, sending Intel, AMD, and Arm shares sharply higher amid broader moves in the AI chip sector.

rel.why: Meta's Muse AI agent is driving CPU demand bets that directly move Intel's stock and competitive position versus AMD, Arm, and Nvidia.

stories.name: AI Chip Market Growth
stories.blurb: A collection of market reports highlighting how AI, 5G, and edge computing are driving rapid growth across semiconductors, chipsets, and related hardware markets where Intel competes.

stories.name: AI chip stock rally
stories.blurb: Investors are debating whether the surging valuations of AI chipmakers like NVIDIA and Marvell are justified by future growth or due for a pullback.

past.name: ASML AI chip demand
past.blurb: ASML is ramping up EUV lithography production and attracting investor attention as surging AI chip demand drives competition among major semiconductor players.

past.name: Apple Ditching Qualcomm
past.blurb: Apple is gradually replacing Qualcomm's modem chips with its own in-house designs, raising questions about Qualcomm's future revenue and stock performance.

4.text: Intel shares fell about 4% after Elon Musk confirmed early talks with TSMC about his Terafab project, where Intel had been the only named chip partner. Intel CEO Lip-Bu Tan then said Intel will keep working on Terafab, and Musk clarified TSMC may only sublease part of the fab.

5.text: Rising Treasury yields and a weak jobs report drove broad market swings, with the Nasdaq hitting a record while the Dow fell. Intel is not mentioned; the volatility affects it only as a rate-sensitive tech stock.

11.text: AMD hit a $1 trillion market cap as AI demand drove record data-center revenue, gigawatt-scale OpenAI and Oracle contracts, and analyst price-target hikes. Articles flag stretched valuation and note the key MI450 GPU hasn't shipped at scale; Intel is not mentioned.

7.text: Intel shares have rallied sharply, up 222% over the past year and 30.9% in four weeks, on AI optimism, data-center chip demand, foundry progress, and seven straight quarters of beating expectations. Analysts debate valuation, citing dilution, weak foundry revenue, and margin concerns.

6.text: Intel and AMD led semiconductor stocks (SOXX) toward their best month since June, rebounding despite rising yields, higher oil prices and AI-demand doubts. Investors await Micron's earnings for the next signal on chip demand.

8.text: Meta's Muse AI agent boom is driving CPU demand, lifting AMD stock to new highs and boosting both AMD and Intel, which have outperformed megacap tech peers over the past month. The shift benefits CPU makers as AI agents juice sales beyond Nvidia's GPU dominance.

13.text: Market research reports forecast growth in embedded, quantum, computer vision, visual computing, confidential computing, and 3D/4D markets, listing Intel among profiled or key players. Intel is not central; the articles only cite it as a participant in these adjacent markets.
